content: Golden-file/snapshot testing for data pipelines: brittleness from nondeterminism (timestamps, float variance, row ordering) and snapshotting too much; consensus pattern is regenerate-mechanically-review-diff-never-hand-edit: one-command regeneration (make update-goldens, pytest --regen, jest -u), CI fails on drift, golden updates land as separate reviewable commits, layer exact goldens on tiny pinned fixtures and schema/summary-statistic assertions on full evolving outputs, scrub/mask volatile fields before compare. Tooling: pytest-regressions, Syrupy, ApprovalTests, Great Expectations/Pandera for contract-style invariants. (Community synthesis; consistent with pytest-regressions/Syrupy documented workflows but not primary-verified this run.)
